description: This file defines the IVSClient class in the Aws\IVS namespace, which extends the AwsClient class. It serves as the client interface for interacting with Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS), providing method signatures for various API operations such as creating, deleting, and listing channels, stream keys, and other resources. The class includes doc comments that specify the available methods, including both synchronous and asynchronous versions.

classes.name: IVSClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS) API. It extends AwsClient and provides methods for managing IVS resources.

methods.name: batchGetChannel
methods.description: Retrieves details about multiple channels in a single request.

methods.name: batchGetChannelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about multiple channels.

methods.name: createChannelAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new IVS channel.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific stream.
